rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – rent control coverage
rules.requirement: Rent control (rent stabilization) applies to most units in multifamily properties built before 1980. Units that were built and received a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980 are only partially covered: they register and have just cause and deposit interest protections, but no rent control.
rules.key_value: Rent control covers most multifamily units built before 1980 (Certificate of Occupancy on or before June 1980)
rules.coverage_conditions: Multifamily units with Certificate of Occupancy on or before June 1980; not owner-occupied Golden Duplex or owner-occupied ADU property
rules.exemptions: No rent control for: new construction with Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980; single-family homes with tenancies that began on or after January 1, 1996; most condominiums; units with Section 202 or Section 811 subsidies; units with Rental Supplement Program, Section 8 Loan Management Set Aside or Project-based Section 8 subsidies in a project with a HUD-insured or HUD-held mortgage. Fully exempt: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant; tenancies starting after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.interaction: Single-family and condominium rent control limits reflect the state Costa-Hawkins Act; the guide does not cite it.
rules.quoted_span: Most units in multifamily properties built before 1980** Fully Covered Yes Yes Yes Yes

rules.title: Berkeley Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance – just cause coverage
rules.requirement: Just cause for eviction protections apply to fully covered units and to partially covered units, including new construction with a Certificate of Occupancy after June 1980, single-family homes, most condominiums and specified subsidized units. Exempt units are listed below.
rules.key_value: Just cause eviction protections cover most Berkeley rental units regardless of construction date
rules.coverage_conditions: All rental units except exempt categories (Golden Duplex, owner-occupied ADU properties, owner shared kitchen/bath, dormitories, nonprofit cooperatives)
rules.exemptions: Exempt: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently has an owner living in one unit); units where the owner shares a kitchen or bath with the tenant, if the owner lived on the property when the tenancy started; tenancies started after Nov 7, 2018 on properties where one unit is an ADU and either unit is owner-occupied; university rental units such as dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
rules.quoted_span: Guide to Coverage under Berkeley’s Rent Stabilization and Eviction for Just Cause Ordinance

rules.title: Berkeley security deposit interest requirement
rules.requirement: Landlords must pay interest on security deposits for both fully and partially covered units under the Berkeley Rent Ordinance, including new construction, single-family homes, condominiums and specified subsidized units. Exempt units have no deposit interest requirement. The guide does not state the interest rate.
rules.key_value: Security deposit interest required for covered units (rate not stated in document)
rules.coverage_conditions: All rental units except exempt categories (Golden Duplex, owner-occupied ADU properties, owner shared kitchen/bath, dormitories, nonprofit cooperatives)
rules.exemptions: Exempt: Golden Duplex (owner-occupied on Dec 31, 1979 and currently owner-occupied); owner shares kitchen or bath with the tenant; tenancies after Nov 7, 2018 on owner-occupied ADU properties; university dormitories; nonprofit cooperatives.
